scope: Continuous-time threshold verification of the exact represented Engine clique model; no external-event or predictive-utility claim.

primary.engine_batches: one batch containing each entity 0..n-1 exactly once
primary.source: SHA256 ASCII 'gabriel-window-source/v1:{seed}:{n}:{entity}'; re=3+(first 8 digest bytes interpreted big-endian mod 17)-8; im=1+(next 8 digest bytes interpreted big-endian mod 19)-9; exact integer values encoded as binary64 bits
primary.threshold: round exact a+q*(abs(b)+abs(c)) once to nearest binary64 after exact clipping to [0,1]
primary.window: round each exact phase endpoint/omega once to nearest binary64; reject rather than replace zero-frequency or nonclique snapshots
primary.selection: all Cartesian-product cases, with no removal or retuning based on outcomes
primary.interpretation: Threshold and phase normalization balance verification coverage. This is a synthetic model-verification cohort, not a sampled external population. The second fixed source seed is included without development screening.

sources: real +1 at entity0 and -1 at entity1, zero elsewhere

stress.source: real one at entity0, zero elsewhere
stress.alias: window [0, round(510*pi/omega)] and threshold round(3/n^2); 256 uniform nodes nominally land at whole periods; endpoint rounding retained
stress.exact_global_equality: window [0, round(2*pi/omega)] and exact rational threshold 4/n^2 where supported; otherwise a separate exact constant-source equality control supplies equality
stress.huge_phase: binary64 window [1e250, nextafter(1e250,+infinity)] and threshold round(2/n^2)
stress.pi_construction: decimal constant 3.14159265358979323846264338327950288419716939937510 used as an exact rational solely to construct rounded input endpoints
stress.purpose: Diagnostic stress fixtures, never substituted for primary cases or used for primary selection.

methods.adaptive: best-first interval subdivision, highest certified interval upper bound first, midpoint queries; exact global amplitude/stationary shortcuts; endpoint Lipschitz envelopes and valid second-derivative interpolation bound; no stationary-point phase solver
methods.uniform: 256 endpoint-inclusive equally spaced rational time points, stop on first certified witness; identical amplitude/stationary shortcuts and interval bounds
methods.shared_model: exact dyadic matrix/source input values, exact rational harmonic coefficients, normalized exact source norm
methods.point_oracle: window_certificate.point_enclosure using Arb at precision schedule 128,256,512
methods.point_refinement: retry the same point at the next precision only while its enclosure width exceeds 2^-96; every attempt counts against the point-evaluation cap
methods.derivative_bounds: Rup is sqrt(b^2+c^2) rounded upward to a dyadic with 128 fractional bits; K1=abs(omega)*Rup, K2=omega^2*Rup. On cell width h with endpoint upper bounds u,v: upper=min(u+K1*h,v+K1*h,(u+v+K1*h)/2,max(u,v)+K2*h^2/8,a+Rup,1).
methods.strict_predicate: exists t in the closed interval with mass(t)>threshold; excluded means mass(t)<=threshold everywhere

acceptance.matched_task_cost: For each fresh worker calculate the median over all primary cases and its three repeats of adaptive_ns/analytic_ns, comparing only paired cases with identical decisive statuses. Require overall median of those worker medians > 1 and at least 4 of 5 worker medians > 1. All exact model preparation and Arb coefficient/phase/extrema/point work are timed. No point-count-only efficiency claim.
acceptance.resolution_secondary_aspiration: analytic minus uniform resolution >=1/10; report separately, not part of primary conjunction
acceptance.failed_criterion: retain every result and report criterion unmet; no cohort, threshold, budget, or method tuning
acceptance.scope: superiority for the declared finite synthetic model-verification cohort; external predictive usefulness and overall Gabriel superiority remain unestablished
acceptance.missing_timing_or_independent_verificati: primary criterion is unassessed, never passed

timing.scope: complete certificate call including exact harmonic preparation and oracle work, excluding native snapshot production, input generation, Python startup and output serialization

evidence: complete Engine snapshot request and response
all certificate outputs and point attempts
per-call raw nanosecond timings and worker process provenance
all primary, control and stress results retained separately
